title: fix(floret): end failed streams with an error event, not missing usage
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Drjacky changed Floret’s failed Chat Completions streams to send an OpenAI-style error event with code `generation_failed` before `[DONE]`, instead of ending without either an error event or terminal usage. The event keeps the generic “Generation failed.” message and does not expose exception details or report success usage. This lets the gen gateway recognize a failed generation rather than reject the stream for missing usage, so clients such as Open WebUI receive the generation error instead of a misleading provider-validation error. Tests cover event ordering and failures after a streamed tool call, with and without `include_usage`.
